mechanism: Isoniazid inhibits CYP2C19 and CYP3A4, increasing carisoprodol metabolism to meprobamate and potentially elevating CNS depressant effects; both drugs also carry hepatotoxicity risk with chronic use.
action: Monitor for increased CNS depression (dizziness, drowsiness, confusion) and consider dose adjustment of carisoprodol; assess liver function periodically given hepatotoxic potential of both agents.
